name: Research Brief
description: A source-preserving application for concise research briefs.

capabilities.label: Render research brief
capabilities.description: Render context, conclusion, evidence, sources, and limitations.
capabilities.purpose: Render a source-preserving Research Brief using the reference behavior or an approved local overlay.
examples: Render the reference brief while keeping every source link visible.
failureModes: A conclusion is shown without linked evidence.

capabilities.label: Configure summary layout
capabilities.description: Change the order in which the conclusion and evidence are presented.
capabilities.purpose: Create a reversible User Overlay for conclusion-first presentation and confirmed preference memory.
sideEffects: Writes a local User Overlay after Contributor approval.
examples: Put the conclusion first for this user without changing the public default.
failureModes: The overlay changes the protected public core.
The preference is saved without confirmation.

protectedInvariants: Source links remain visible and attached to evidence.
The public default does not change without Maintainer approval.
Private preferences are not submitted automatically.
Project Agent completion requires verifier evidence.
Final public adoption belongs to the Maintainer.
